statement:
by
  classical
  let S := fun {r s : ℕ} (α : DirichletCharacter ℂ r) (β : DirichletCharacter ℂ s) (m : ℕ) =>
    ∑' q : ℕ, if hq : q ≠ 0 then
      let _ : NeZero q := ⟨hq⟩
      if h : r ∣ q ∧ s ∣ q then
        let A := DirichletCharacter.changeLevel h.1 α
        let B := DirichletCharacter.changeLevel h.2 β
        gaussSum A ZMod.stdAddChar * gaussSum B ZMod.stdAddChar *
          gaussSum (A*B)⁻¹ (ZMod.stdAddChar.mulShift (-(m:ZMod q))) / (q.totient:ℂ)^2
      else 0
    else 0
  let O := S (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ 1) (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ 1)
  let P := (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ 1)
  let B := Σ s : ℕ, DirichletCharacter ℂ s
  let valid := fun b : B => b.1 ≠ 0 ∧ b.2.IsPrimitive
  exact ∀ (r : ℕ) [NeZero r] (α : DirichletCharacter ℂ r), α.IsPrimitive → ∀ m : ℕ, 0 < m → Even m → ∃ b₀ : ℝ, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ T : ℕ, ∀ Y ≥ T, ∃ F : Finset B, (∀ b, b ∈ F ↔ valid b ∧ b.1 ≤ Y) ∧ |(∑ b ∈ F, ‖S α b.2 m‖^2) - ‖O m‖ * Real.log (Y:ℝ) - b₀| ≤ ε

plain_statement.zh: 按搭档导子 ≤Y 截断，求平方质量的对数主项并证明扣除后收敛到常数。
plain_statement.en: Renormalize the quadratic mass by a conductor-height cutoff and obtain a constant secondary term.

brief.zh: #4316 按整除共同水平取完整行。高度截断恰是另一族集合。先剥离 r 与 m 的有限局部项，再把剩余平方质量写成与调和级数的卷积。预期未归一化主项系数为普通奇异级数的模，常数项可依赖固定行及目标。
brief.en: A height cutoff differs from divisibility by one level. Peel off the finite local factors of r and m and factor the outer Dirichlet series against the harmonic series. Predict the unnormalized leading coefficient ‖O(m)‖ and retain a row-dependent constant term.
